package student

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type LearningJourneyClock interface{ Now() time.Time }
type LearningJourneyIDGenerator interface{ NewID() string }

type ReplaceLearningPathInput struct {
	ExpectedOnboardingVersion int64
	ExpectedDirectionCode     string
	StudentID                 string
	PlanningRequestID         string
	IdempotencyKey            string
	CourseID                  string
	GoalCode                  string
	CurriculumRevision        string
	PlannerPolicyVersion      string
	ReasonCode                string
	ReasonSummary             string
	ExpectedVersion           int64
	Items                     []domain.LearningPathItem
}

type ReplaceLearningPath struct {
	Revisions LessonRevisionProvider
	Journey   repository.LearningJourneyRepository
	Clock     LearningJourneyClock
	IDs       LearningJourneyIDGenerator
}

type CompleteLearningPathInput struct {
	StudentID            string
	GoalCode             string
	CourseFingerprint    string
	PlannerPolicyVersion string
	ReasonCode           string
	ReasonSummary        string
	ExpectedVersion      int64
}

type CompleteLearningPath struct {
	Journey repository.LearningJourneyRepository
	Clock   LearningJourneyClock
}

func (useCase CompleteLearningPath) Handle(
	ctx context.Context,
	input CompleteLearningPathInput,
) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.GoalCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.GoalCode))
	input.CourseFingerprint = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseFingerprint)
	input.PlannerPolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlannerPolicyVersion)
	input.ReasonCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.ReasonCode))
	input.ReasonSummary = strings.TrimSpace(input.ReasonSummary)
	if useCase.Journey == nil || useCase.Clock == nil || !validStudentUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		input.ExpectedVersion < 1 || input.GoalCode == "" || input.CourseFingerprint == "" ||
		input.PlannerPolicyVersion == "" || input.ReasonCode != "mastery_no_gap" || input.ReasonSummary == "" {
		return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	current, err := useCase.Journey.GetLearningPath(ctx, input.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, err
	}
	if current.Version != input.ExpectedVersion || current.GoalCode != input.GoalCode ||
		current.CourseFingerprint != input.CourseFingerprint {
		return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	alreadyCompleted := current.ReasonCode == input.ReasonCode
	for _, item := range current.Items {
		if item.Status != domain.LearningPathItemCompleted && item.Status != domain.LearningPathItemSkippedMastered {
			alreadyCompleted = false
			break
		}
	}
	if alreadyCompleted {
		return current, nil
	}
	for index := range current.Items {
		if current.Items[index].Status == domain.LearningPathItemCompleted ||
			current.Items[index].Status == domain.LearningPathItemSkippedMastered {
			continue
		}
		current.Items[index].Status = domain.LearningPathItemSkippedMastered
		current.Items[index].ReasonCode = input.ReasonCode
	}
	current.PlannerPolicyVersion = input.PlannerPolicyVersion
	current.ReasonCode = input.ReasonCode
	current.ReasonSummary = input.ReasonSummary
	current.Version++
	current.UpdatedAt = useCase.Clock.Now().UTC()
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeStudentLearningPath(current)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.Journey.ReplaceLearningPath(ctx, normalized, input.ExpectedVersion)
}

func (useCase ReplaceLearningPath) Handle(ctx context.Context, input ReplaceLearningPathInput) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.PlanningRequestID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlanningRequestID)
	input.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey)
	if useCase.Journey == nil || useCase.Clock == nil || useCase.IDs == nil || !validStudentUUID(input.StudentID) || input.ExpectedVersion < 0 {
		return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	idempotentCreate := input.PlanningRequestID != "" || input.IdempotencyKey != ""
	input.ExpectedDirectionCode = strings.TrimSpace(input.ExpectedDirectionCode)
	fenced := input.ExpectedOnboardingVersion != 0 || input.ExpectedDirectionCode != ""
	if fenced && (!idempotentCreate || input.ExpectedVersion != 0 || input.ExpectedOnboardingVersion < 1 || input.ExpectedDirectionCode == "") {
		return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if idempotentCreate && (input.ExpectedVersion != 0 || !validStudentUUID(input.PlanningRequestID) || !validStudentUUID(input.IdempotencyKey)) {
		return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var existingItems []domain.LearningPathItem
	var originalHash string
	if useCase.Revisions != nil && idempotentCreate {
		originalHash = learningPathCreationRequestHash(domain.StudentLearningPath{StudentID: input.StudentID, CourseID: input.CourseID, GoalCode: input.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: input.CurriculumRevision, PlannerPolicyVersion: input.PlannerPolicyVersion, ReasonCode: input.ReasonCode, ReasonSummary: input.ReasonSummary, Items: input.Items}, repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{ExpectedOnboardingVersion: input.ExpectedOnboardingVersion, ExpectedDirectionCode: input.ExpectedDirectionCode})
		if reader, ok := useCase.Journey.(interface {
			ReplayLearningPathCreation(context.Context, string, string, string, string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, bool, error)
		}); ok {
			stored, replayed, err := reader.ReplayLearningPathCreation(ctx, input.StudentID, input.IdempotencyKey, input.PlanningRequestID, originalHash)
			if err != nil {
				return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, err
			}
			if replayed {
				return stored, nil
			}
		}
	}
	now := useCase.Clock.Now().UTC()
	pathID := useCase.IDs.NewID()
	createdAt := now
	status := domain.LearningPathStatusActive
	isPrimary := input.ExpectedVersion == 0 && !idempotentCreate
	if input.ExpectedVersion > 0 {
		current, err := useCase.Journey.GetLearningPath(ctx, input.StudentID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, err
		}
		if current.Version != input.ExpectedVersion {
			return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		existingItems = current.Items
		pathID, createdAt = current.ID, current.CreatedAt
		status, isPrimary = current.Status, current.IsPrimary
	}
	if useCase.Revisions != nil {
		seed := input.PlanningRequestID
		if seed == "" {
			seed = pathID
		}
		var err error
		input.Items, err = freezeLessonItems(ctx, useCase.Revisions, input.Items, seed, existingItems)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, err
		}
	}
	path, err := domain.NormalizeStudentLearningPath(domain.StudentLearningPath{
		ID: pathID, StudentID: input.StudentID, CourseID: input.CourseID, GoalCode: input.GoalCode,
		CurriculumRevision: input.CurriculumRevision, PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion,
		PlannerPolicyVersion: input.PlannerPolicyVersion,
		ReasonCode:           input.ReasonCode, ReasonSummary: input.ReasonSummary, Version: input.ExpectedVersion + 1,
		Status: status, IsPrimary: isPrimary,
		Items: input.Items, CreatedAt: createdAt, UpdatedAt: now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if !idempotentCreate {
		return useCase.Journey.ReplaceLearningPath(ctx, path, input.ExpectedVersion)
	}
	creator, ok := useCase.Journey.(repository.IdempotentLearningPathRepository)
	if !ok {
		return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	request := repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{
		IdempotencyKey: input.IdempotencyKey, PlanningRequestID: input.PlanningRequestID,
		ExpectedOnboardingVersion: input.ExpectedOnboardingVersion, ExpectedDirectionCode: input.ExpectedDirectionCode,
	}
	request.RequestHash = learningPathCreationRequestHash(path, request)
	if originalHash != "" {
		request.RequestHash = originalHash
	}
	stored, _, err := creator.CreateLearningPathIdempotently(ctx, path, request)
	return stored, err
}

func learningPathCreationRequestHash(path domain.StudentLearningPath, fences ...repository.LearningPathCreationRequest) string {
	payload := struct {
		ExpectedOnboardingVersion int64                     `json:"expected_onboarding_version,omitempty"`
		ExpectedDirectionCode     string                    `json:"expected_direction_code,omitempty"`
		StudentID                 string                    `json:"student_id"`
		CourseID                  string                    `json:"course_id"`
		GoalCode                  string                    `json:"goal_code"`
		CourseFingerprint         string                    `json:"course_fingerprint"`
		PlannerPolicyVersion      string                    `json:"planner_policy_version"`
		ReasonCode                string                    `json:"reason_code"`
		ReasonSummary             string                    `json:"reason_summary"`
		Items                     []domain.LearningPathItem `json:"items"`
	}{
		StudentID: path.StudentID, CourseID: path.CourseID, GoalCode: path.GoalCode,
		CourseFingerprint: path.CourseFingerprint, PlannerPolicyVersion: path.PlannerPolicyVersion,
		ReasonCode: path.ReasonCode, ReasonSummary: path.ReasonSummary, Items: path.Items,
	}
	if len(fences) > 0 {
		payload.ExpectedOnboardingVersion = fences[0].ExpectedOnboardingVersion
		payload.ExpectedDirectionCode = fences[0].ExpectedDirectionCode
	}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}

type GetLearningPath struct {
	Journey repository.LearningJourneyRepository
}

func (useCase GetLearningPath) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if useCase.Journey == nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) {
		return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.Journey.GetLearningPath(ctx, studentID)
}

type LearningPaths struct {
	Paths repository.LearningPathStateRepository
	Clock LearningJourneyClock
}

func (useCase LearningPaths) List(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentLearningPathList, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if useCase.Paths == nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) {
		return domain.StudentLearningPathList{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var paths []domain.StudentLearningPath
	var contextValue domain.StudentLearningContext
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 3; attempt++ {
		before, err := useCase.contextOrEmpty(ctx, studentID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningPathList{}, err
		}
		paths, err = useCase.Paths.ListLearningPaths(ctx, studentID, 100)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningPathList{}, err
		}
		contextValue, err = useCase.contextOrEmpty(ctx, studentID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningPathList{}, err
		}
		if before.Version == contextValue.Version {
			break
		}
		if attempt == 2 {
			return domain.StudentLearningPathList{}, domain.ErrConflict
		}
	}
	result := domain.StudentLearningPathList{
		Schema: domain.LearningPathListSchemaVersion, StudentID: studentID,
		JourneyVersion: contextValue.Version, Items: make([]domain.StudentLearningPathSummary, 0, len(paths)),
	}
	for _, path := range paths {
		summary, err := domain.SummarizeStudentLearningPath(path, contextValue.SelectedLearningPathID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningPathList{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		result.Items = append(result.Items, summary)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (useCase LearningPaths) Get(ctx context.Context, studentID, pathID string) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	pathID = strings.TrimSpace(pathID)
	if useCase.Paths == nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) || !validStudentUUID(pathID) {
		return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var path domain.StudentLearningPath
	var contextValue domain.StudentLearningContext
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 3; attempt++ {
		before, err := useCase.contextOrEmpty(ctx, studentID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{}, err
		}
		path, err = useCase.Paths.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, studentID, pathID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{}, err
		}
		contextValue, err = useCase.contextOrEmpty(ctx, studentID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{}, err
		}
		if before.Version == contextValue.Version {
			break
		}
		if attempt == 2 {
			return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{}, domain.ErrConflict
		}
	}
	path.IsSelected = contextValue.SelectedLearningPathID == path.ID
	return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{Path: path, Context: contextValue}, nil
}

func (useCase LearningPaths) GetContext(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentLearningContext, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if useCase.Paths == nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) {
		return domain.StudentLearningContext{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.contextOrEmpty(ctx, studentID)
}

func (useCase LearningPaths) Activate(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	pathID string,
	expectedJourneyVersion int64,
	makePrimary bool,
) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error) {
	if err := useCase.validateMutation(studentID, pathID, expectedJourneyVersion); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{}, err
	}
	return useCase.Paths.ActivateLearningPath(
		ctx, strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(pathID), expectedJourneyVersion, makePrimary, useCase.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	)
}

func (useCase LearningPaths) Pause(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	pathID string,
	expectedJourneyVersion int64,
) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error) {
	if err := useCase.validateMutation(studentID, pathID, expectedJourneyVersion); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{}, err
	}
	return useCase.Paths.PauseLearningPath(
		ctx, strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(pathID), expectedJourneyVersion, useCase.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	)
}

func (useCase LearningPaths) Resume(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	pathID string,
	expectedJourneyVersion int64,
) (domain.StudentLearningPathMutation, error) {
	if err := useCase.validateMutation(studentID, pathID, expectedJourneyVersion); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningPathMutation{}, err
	}
	return useCase.Paths.ResumeLearningPath(
		ctx, strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(pathID), expectedJourneyVersion, useCase.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	)
}

func (useCase LearningPaths) contextOrEmpty(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentLearningContext, error) {
	contextValue, err := useCase.Paths.GetLearningContext(ctx, studentID)
	if err == nil {
		return contextValue, nil
	}
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		return domain.StudentLearningContext{}, err
	}
	return domain.NormalizeStudentLearningContext(domain.StudentLearningContext{
		Schema: domain.LearningContextSchemaVersion, StudentID: studentID,
	})
}

func (useCase LearningPaths) validateMutation(studentID, pathID string, expectedJourneyVersion int64) error {
	if useCase.Paths == nil || useCase.Clock == nil || !validStudentUUID(strings.TrimSpace(studentID)) ||
		!validStudentUUID(strings.TrimSpace(pathID)) || expectedJourneyVersion < 1 {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

type CaptureDiagnosticInput struct {
	StudentID          string
	AssessmentID       string
	CurriculumRevision string
	Targets            []domain.LearningTargetRef
}

type TargetMasteryProjection interface {
	Handle(context.Context, string, []domain.LearningTargetRef) ([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, error)
}

type CaptureDiagnosticSnapshot struct {
	Journey repository.LearningJourneyRepository
	Mastery TargetMasteryProjection
	Clock   LearningJourneyClock
	IDs     LearningJourneyIDGenerator
}

func (useCase CaptureDiagnosticSnapshot) Handle(ctx context.Context, input CaptureDiagnosticInput) (domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	if useCase.Journey == nil || useCase.Mastery == nil || useCase.Clock == nil || useCase.IDs == nil ||
		!validStudentUUID(input.StudentID) || len(input.Targets) < 1 || len(input.Targets) > 500 {
		return domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	projections := make([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, 0, len(input.Targets))
	for start := 0; start < len(input.Targets); start += 100 {
		end := start + 100
		if end > len(input.Targets) {
			end = len(input.Targets)
		}
		items, err := useCase.Mastery.Handle(ctx, input.StudentID, input.Targets[start:end])
		if err != nil {
			return domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot{}, err
		}
		if len(items) != end-start {
			return domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		projections = append(projections, items...)
	}
	items := make([]domain.DiagnosticSnapshotItem, len(projections))
	for index, projection := range projections {
		items[index] = domain.DiagnosticSnapshotItem{
			Target: projection.Target, State: projection.State,
			MasteryScore: projection.MasteryScore, Confidence: projection.Confidence,
		}
	}
	snapshot, err := domain.NormalizeStudentDiagnosticSnapshot(domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot{
		ID: useCase.IDs.NewID(), StudentID: input.StudentID, AssessmentID: input.AssessmentID,
		CurriculumRevision: input.CurriculumRevision, PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticPolicyVersion,
		Items: items, CompletedAt: useCase.Clock.Now(),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.Journey.SaveDiagnosticSnapshot(ctx, snapshot)
}

type LearningSessionMetrics struct {
	AnalyticsSessionID       string
	ActiveLearningSeconds    int
	LessonCount              int
	TaskCount                int
	QuestionCount            int
	SelectedExplanationCount int
	CodeRunCount             int
	FailureCount             int
	PassedTestCount          int
	HintCount                int
	TeacherInterventionCount int
	StuckSignalCount         int
}

type LearningSessions struct {
	Journey repository.LearningJourneyRepository
	Clock   LearningJourneyClock
	IDs     LearningJourneyIDGenerator
}

func (useCase LearningSessions) Start(ctx context.Context, studentID, goal, courseID, lessonID, taskID, analyticsSessionID string) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if useCase.Journey == nil || useCase.Clock == nil || useCase.IDs == nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	now := useCase.Clock.Now().UTC()
	session, err := domain.NormalizeStudentLearningSession(domain.StudentLearningSession{
		ID: useCase.IDs.NewID(), StudentID: studentID, Goal: goal, CourseID: courseID, LessonID: lessonID, TaskID: taskID,
		AnalyticsSessionID: analyticsSessionID,
		SchemaVersion:      domain.LearningSessionVersion, Version: 1, StartedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.Journey.CreateLearningSession(ctx, session)
}

func (useCase LearningSessions) End(ctx context.Context, studentID, sessionID string, expectedVersion int64) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error) {
	studentID, sessionID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(sessionID)
	if useCase.Journey == nil || useCase.Clock == nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) || !validStudentUUID(sessionID) || expectedVersion < 1 {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	current, err := useCase.Journey.GetLearningSession(ctx, studentID, sessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, err
	}
	if current.Version != expectedVersion || current.EndedAt != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	now := useCase.Clock.Now().UTC()
	current.EndedAt, current.UpdatedAt, current.Version = &now, now, expectedVersion+1
	return useCase.Journey.UpdateLearningSession(ctx, current, expectedVersion)
}

func (useCase LearningSessions) ApplyMetrics(ctx context.Context, studentID, sessionID string, expectedVersion int64, metrics LearningSessionMetrics) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error) {
	studentID, sessionID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(sessionID)
	if useCase.Journey == nil || useCase.Clock == nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) || !validStudentUUID(sessionID) || expectedVersion < 1 {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	current, err := useCase.Journey.GetLearningSession(ctx, studentID, sessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, err
	}
	if current.Version != expectedVersion {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	stored := current
	current.AnalyticsSessionID = strings.TrimSpace(metrics.AnalyticsSessionID)
	current.ActiveLearningSeconds = metrics.ActiveLearningSeconds
	current.LessonCount = metrics.LessonCount
	current.TaskCount = metrics.TaskCount
	current.QuestionCount = metrics.QuestionCount
	current.SelectedExplanationCount = metrics.SelectedExplanationCount
	current.CodeRunCount = metrics.CodeRunCount
	current.FailureCount = metrics.FailureCount
	current.PassedTestCount = metrics.PassedTestCount
	current.HintCount = metrics.HintCount
	current.TeacherInterventionCount = metrics.TeacherInterventionCount
	current.StuckSignalCount = metrics.StuckSignalCount
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeStudentLearningSession(current); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if learningSessionMetricsEqual(stored, current) {
		return current, nil
	}
	current.Version++
	current.UpdatedAt = useCase.Clock.Now().UTC()
	if _, err := domain.NormalizeStudentLearningSession(current); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.Journey.UpdateLearningSession(ctx, current, expectedVersion)
}

func learningSessionMetricsEqual(stored, proposed domain.StudentLearningSession) bool {
	return stored.AnalyticsSessionID == proposed.AnalyticsSessionID &&
		stored.ActiveLearningSeconds == proposed.ActiveLearningSeconds && stored.LessonCount == proposed.LessonCount &&
		stored.TaskCount == proposed.TaskCount && stored.QuestionCount == proposed.QuestionCount &&
		stored.SelectedExplanationCount == proposed.SelectedExplanationCount && stored.CodeRunCount == proposed.CodeRunCount &&
		stored.FailureCount == proposed.FailureCount && stored.PassedTestCount == proposed.PassedTestCount &&
		stored.HintCount == proposed.HintCount && stored.TeacherInterventionCount == proposed.TeacherInterventionCount &&
		stored.StuckSignalCount == proposed.StuckSignalCount
}

func (useCase LearningSessions) Get(ctx context.Context, studentID, sessionID string) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error) {
	studentID, sessionID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(sessionID)
	if useCase.Journey == nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) || !validStudentUUID(sessionID) {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.Journey.GetLearningSession(ctx, studentID, sessionID)
}

func (useCase LearningSessions) ListRecent(ctx context.Context, studentID string, limit int) ([]domain.StudentLearningSession, error) {
	if useCase.Journey == nil || !validStudentUUID(strings.TrimSpace(studentID)) {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if limit == 0 {
		limit = 5
	}
	if limit < 1 || limit > 20 {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return useCase.Journey.ListRecentLearningSessions(ctx, strings.TrimSpace(studentID), limit)
}

func validStudentUUID(value string) bool {
	_, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil
}
